versions.content: The function name of each instance of FrIf_JobListExec_<FrIf Cluster.ShortName> shall contain the short name of the respective FlexRay Cluster (FrIfCluster). For each FlexRay Cluster (identified by index ClstIdx), the respective API service FrIf_ JobListExec_<FrIfCluster.ShortName> must be registered in the AUTOSAR OS as the ISR of an absolute timer of a FlexRay CC connected to the FlexRay Cluster with index ClstIdx, if the CC does not guarantee asynchronous buffer access.
